newsitem.title: UK: Japan's JDB to raise 50 bln yen 10-yr bond - Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Japan's JDB to raise 50 bln yen 10-yr bond - Nomura.

text.p: Nomura International Plc has been awarded the mandate to launch a 50 billion yen 10-year Eurobond for the Japan Development Bank.
The Eurobond, guaranteed by Japan, will be launched in the near future. It will be rated triple-A by both Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's Corp.
A Nomura syndicate official said the deal would be internationally-targeted.
"It is not targeted at Japan at all," he said.
A syndicate manager at another Japanese bank said the spread could come at three basis points over the 189 or 190 Japanese government bond (JGB).
"This could give it a coupon of around 2.75 percent," he said.
JDB have a number of outstanding issues but it has kept a very low profile this year.
In February, JDB launched a 200 million stg June 2003 bond via HSBC Markets and SBC Warburg. It was launched at a spread of 20 basis points over gilts.
